newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Sabena aims for one bln bfr 1997 current loss.
newsitem.headline: Sabena aims for one bln bfr 1997 current loss.

text.p: Sabena SA aims to cut its current loss to just over one billion Belgian francs in 1997, the Belgian carrier's Swiss financial director was quoted as saying in Wednesday's De Financieel Economische Tijd paper.
"We're aiming this year for a current loss of slightly more than one billion francs," Peter Ramel said.
The airline, 49.5 percent owned by Swissair, had a 1996 net loss after provisions of 8.87 billion Belgian francs and current (pre-tax) loss of 4.28 billion francs.
Ramel said that after four months in 1997, Sabena was still on schedule to return to profit in 1998.
